newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks end on year-end window-dressing.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks end on year-end window-dressing.

text.p: Taiwan share prices closed slightly higher on Monday on year-end window-dressing by local securities trust funds, brokers said.
The index ended up 22.37 points, or 0.32 percent, at 6,926.27, off a 6,945.90 high. Turnover was T$44.4 billion.
Brokers noted caution nearing resistance around 6,950-7,000.
"The market simply lacked bellwether shares to lead stronger upward momentum, especailly nearing the 6,950-7,000 resistance," said Yuanta Securities analyst Tank Hung.
Previous bellwether shares, financials and electronics, either were stable or fell slightly.
Automobile, chemicals and retail shares attracted most buying. Car maker Sanyang rose by the daily seven percent limit to T$62.5. Tonlin Department Store was limit up to T$43.3 on listing debut.

Brokers said they expected the index to continue testing 6,950 on Tuesday. "Securities trust funds' window-dressing will likely continue to support the market, but it's hard to stand above 6,960 on the last trading day of the year," Hung said.
A 6,900-6,960 range was seen for Tuesday.-JamesPeng(5080815)
